decisions.title: Client scope and portal grants
decisions.owner: Product owner and participating office owner
decisions.gate: G0 before WP1; final grant policy before S43/S44
options: Independent client records per office, separate portal identities and explicit representative-approved grants.
A shared global client directory with office relationships and a separate ownership model.
decisions.recommendation: Keep client records office-scoped, allowing the same AFM in different offices. Separate staff membership, portal identity, representative verification and data grants. Revocation blocks the next protected action and queued job execution.
unresolved: Evidence and reviewer needed to verify a business representative.
Who can grant access, to which files/services, and for how long?
Treatment of multiple representatives, disputes and staff reassignment.

decisions.title: Authorised government-service access
decisions.status: Documentary feasibility reviewed; access not demonstrated
decisions.gate: G0 before connector commitment; S49 contract gate
confirmed: Use current official contracts; unavailable or unapproved retrieval is never represented as success.
options: Use documented service-specific interfaces after proving eligibility and client authority.
Keep a connector unavailable pending approved access; allow separately reviewed manual document upload where the document module permits it.
decisions.recommendation: Prioritise AADE basic registry, myDATA ERP retrieval and VIES documentary routes. Keep full TAXISnet profiles, AADE debt retrieval and e-EFKA retrieval conditional. Do not infer private-SaaS eligibility from a public-sector endpoint or portal login.
unresolved: Service-specific account registrations, credentials and client delegation.
Permitted production use and contract/schema versions at S49.
Redacted response fixtures, negative cases, rate limits and document ownership checks.

decisions.title: Tax forecast coverage and reference cases
options: Release a named taxpayer/year subset backed by reviewed reference cases.
Attempt all taxpayer types and years in the first forecast release.
decisions.recommendation: Approve a narrow, explicit coverage matrix before coding calculation rules. Unsupported cases show a Greek explanation. Treat results as forecasts, retain rule/input snapshots and keep office fees separate from client tax sources.
unresolved: Supported tax years, taxpayer types, VAT regimes and form versions.
Rounding, code 401 provenance, corrections and missing-data handling.
Accountant-approved ordinary, zero, credit and boundary examples for VAT, income tax and presumptive expenses.

decisions.title: Legacy ownership and cutover
decisions.status: Pending; synthetic rehearsal may proceed later
confirmed: Preserve existing migration identities; no live client data before release and restore gates.
options: Controlled migration with explicit ownership mappings, financial reconciliation and exception quarantine.
Start a new office with approved opening balances and retain a restricted legacy archive.
decisions.recommendation: Prepare a repeatable dry run with source snapshot identity, user-to-office mapping, dated opening balances, paired transfers and an exception report. Do not silently repair ambiguous records.
unresolved: Which legacy users and records belong to which office?
Opening dates, reconciled cash totals, charges, allocations, credit and unmatched transfer pairs.
Cutover freeze, reviewer sign-off and rollback owner.

decisions.title: Workload, service targets and sizing
decisions.owner: Product owner and operator (operator to be assigned)
decisions.status: Proposed targets; workload and budget pending
decisions.gate: G0 sizing; S08 parameters; S31/S63 load evidence
confirmed: Initial hosting is one Google Cloud VM.
options: A standard non-Spot VM sized for a measured pilot; resize after observing memory and load.
A smaller shared-core VM with lower cost and reduced headroom, subject to measured acceptance.
decisions.recommendation: Use e2-standard-2 (2 vCPU, 8 GB) as a provisional pilot candidate. Measure before accepting capacity; file scanning and S26 workers share resources. One VM is a single failure domain.
unresolved: Office/accountant/client counts, concurrent sessions and annual transaction volume.
Upload size/type/count limits, storage growth, task volume and retention.
Monthly budget and EU region; confirm proposed p95 2-second list/detail and 10-second annual report at 50 sessions, 99.5% availability, RPO 24h/RTO 8h and WCAG 2.2 AA.

decisions.title: Data retention, secrets and operational responsibility
decisions.owner: Office owner and operator (people to be assigned)
decisions.gate: S08 hosting inputs; before R1 live use and R2 portal use
confirmed: Private documents and credentials must be protected; public repository contains no live secrets.
options: Versioned per-category retention and access policy, off-VM backups and recoverable separately controlled keys.
A blanket retention period for all records (not recommended; conflicts and holds must first be resolved).
decisions.recommendation: Use an EU hosting location, a dedicated VM identity, least-privilege access and secret-version references. Approve retention by category and assign incident, restore, key recovery and client-request owners before live use.
unresolved: Exact region and access administrators; key custodians and recovery rehearsal.
Retention/archive/deletion/hold rules for financial records, files, messages, source data, audit logs and backups.
Who handles incidents, restore tests, client exports/deletion requests and supplier account changes?

decisions.title: Office financial posting policy
decisions.status: Approved for reviewed ACC-FIN-001 v0.1 snapshot; implementation and release acceptance Pending
options: Separate agreement terms, dated charges, cash, allocations, client credit and linked reversals.
Treat agreement value as received/paid cash (rejected by the planned separation of obligations and settlement).
decisions.recommendation: Implement the separate posting model in S17 onward with fixed decimal money, atomic transfer pairs and attributable reversals. Never infer paid status from agreement value alone.
unresolved: Unimplemented/excluded operations remain outside the reviewed first scope; later changes require review.

s17_preparation.status: Bound declared review approved; implementation/release acceptance Pending

s23_implementation.allocation: Explicit positive exact-amount same-party/direction allocations; no implicit FIFO or offset
s23_implementation.release: Owner-only finance.release; password, recent MFA, date/reason; one immutable full release
s23_implementation.correction: Cash reversal requires prior explicit releases; grouped cash correction/refund UI remains S24

s24_implementation.correction: Full linked originals, grouped allocation releases and dependent refund reversals; optional replacement with separate explicit reallocation
s24_implementation.refund: Explicit original-bound credit/advance only, never automatic netting
s24_implementation.lifecycle: Prospective retained versions; cancellation stops new charges while retaining debt
s24_implementation.closed_period: Explicit owner cutoff; forward only, subsequent corrections use an open date
